name: Spicy Cajun Sausage-Veggie Skillet with Kidney Beans, Rice & Corn on the Cob (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add tomatoes and broth, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, slice the sausages crosswise into 1/2-inch thick rounds.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water comes to a boil, using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Trim and medium dice zucchini. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp smoked paprika
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, remove and discard outer husks and silk from corn. Cut one cob in half crosswise.
Once the water is boiling, uncover the pot and reduce heat to medium; use tongs to lower the corn into the water and cook until just tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.

When the veggies have softened, return sausage to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sausage is warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Transfer 1 ½ cups of sausage and veggies to a clean plate and set aside. Add hot sauce to the skillet with the remaining sausage and veggies, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Add 1 cup of tomato rice to the plate with the sausage and veggies. Add beans and Cajun seasoning to the pan with the remaining rice and stir well to combine.
Butter corn, then season with salt and pepper as desired.
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide reserved tomato rice, sausage, veggies, and corn cob halves between plates, separating the different foods, if desired. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide rice and beans, sausage-veggie skillet, and remaining corn between plates. Enjoy!
